Compatibility guide also states a public checkout with supplied decrypted inputs plus local manifest can build/play a package; private full-build developer route reaches3Dmatch gameplay with sound. steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA UCUS98701 owned ISO plus locally supplied decrypted EBOOT.elf and required decrypted modules; local title manifest. Optional own PSPPGF fonts for authentic typography; no bundled decryption. PGD/amctrl-protected data fails closed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: No release; source-built Windows11x64 player and local package build using user inputs/manifest. RawISO-toPlay without manifest/developer toolchain still in progress.
